import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static class NetworkFlow {
        static class Node {
            int v, w, rev;
        }

        int INF = (int) 1e9;
        int st, ed;
        int nodecnt;
        int[][] adj;
        int[] lev;
        int[] edge_tried;
        NetworkFlow(int V, int s, int t) {
            adj = new int[V][];
            lev = new int[V];
            edge_tried = new int[V];
            st = s;
            ed = t;
            nodecnt = V;
        }

        boolean assign_level() {
            Arrays.fill(lev, -1);
            lev[st] = 0;
            ArrayDeque<Integer> que = new ArrayDeque<>();
            que.add(st);
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                int now = que.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < adj[now].length; i++) {
                    int nxt = adj[now][i].v;
                    if (lev[nxt] == -1 && adj[now][i].w != 0) {
                        lev[nxt] = lev[now] + 1;
                        que.add(nxt);
                    }
                }
            }
            return (lev[ed] != -1);
        }

        int dfs(int now, int fl) {
            if (now == ed) return fl;
            for (int i = edge_tried[now]; i < adj[now].length; i++) {
                int nxt = adj[now][i].v;
                if (lev[nxt] == lev[now] + 1 && adj[now][i].w != 0) {
                    int nxtflow = dfs(nxt, Math.min(fl, adj[now][i].w));
                    if (nxtflow != 0) {
                        adj[now][i].w -= nxtflow;
                        adj[nxt][adj[now][i].rev].w += nxtflow;
                        return nxtflow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long dinic() {
            long ret = 0;
            while (assign_level()) {
                Arrays.fill(edge_tried, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int amt = dfs(st, INF);
                    if (amt == 0) break;
                    ret += amt;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static int n, ti;
    static String[] str;
    static String[] es;
    static int[][] ck;
    static int yy, xx;
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[][][] table;

    static void go() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        ti = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        str = new String[n];
        es = new String[n];
        ck = new int[n][n];
        table = new int[n][n][65];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            str[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (str[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    yy = i;
                    xx = j;
                }
            }
        }
        br.readLine();
        br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            es[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        go();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ('0' <= str[i].charAt(j) && str[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    if (ck[i][j] == 0) ck[i][j] = ti;
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        table[i][j][t] = ++nodecnt;
                    }
                }
                if ('1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    table[i][j][ck[i][j]] = ++nodecnt;
                }
            }
        }
        NetworkFlow net = new NetworkFlow(nodecnt + 5, 0, nodecnt + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if ('1' <= str[i].charAt(j) && str[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    net.setEdge(0, table[i][j][0], str[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
                for (int ite = 0; ite < 4; ite++) {
                    int ny = i + dy[ite];
                    int nx = j + dx[ite];
                    if (!(ny >= 0 && ny < n && nx >= 0 && nx < n)) continue;
                    if (str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y' || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int t = 0; ; t++) {
                        if (table[i][j][t] == 0) break;
                        if (t == ck[i][j] && '1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') break;
                        if (table[ny][nx][t + 1] != 0) {
                            net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[ny][nx][t + 1], net.INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if ('1' <= es[i].charAt(j) && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[i][j][t + 1], net.INF);
                    }
                    net.setEdge(table[i][j][ck[i][j]], nodecnt + 3, es[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(net.dinic());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        go();
    }
}
